_README: Single source of truth for the two event spaces. Imported by the pages, by
the JSON-LD builder, and required by backend/api/routes/venues.js, so it is
listed in vercel.json includeFiles to survive the serverless trace.
ORDER IS MEANINGFUL. The array order drives the switch on /private-events,
and FOODIST is first because it is the primary home (owner, 2026-09-17).
`verified` is a publishing gate, not a comment. While it is false the page
still renders, but buildVenueJsonLd() refuses to emit Place / PostalAddress
/ geo, and the page sends noindex. A name-address-phone mismatch against the
Google Business Profile is worse for ranking than emitting nothing at all.
Flip it to true only once every TODO below is replaced with the value that
is actually on the Business Profile.
Accents are NOT free choices. Each traces to a measured value in
brand-tokens.css:83-85 sampled from the reference set, and each is fenced at
roughly 4% coverage as a rule or a strike, never a fill. They are also
CATEGORICAL, not hierarchical: FOODIST being the primary home is expressed
by order, not by a louder colour. See docs/design/VENUES.md.
roomFeeCents is NOT free either. It mirrors the owner price book
(backend/api/pricing/priceBookManifest.js, rules small_event.venue.*) and
the deposit endpoint re-derives from that manifest, never from this file.
Change the manifest first; this is the copy the page prints.
NOT IN THIS FILE: the Hopkins facility. It is neither of these spaces — it
is backup capacity for large events and frozen pizza production, has no
public booking page, and must not be given one by pattern-matching.
_sharedPhotosREADME: The food is the same whichever room it is served in — that is the whole
thesis of these pages — so these plates are shared rather than copied onto
each venue. Venue-specific photographs stay under the venue.
Cloudinary public_ids, NOT display names. The owner names assets by their
camera filename (IMG_6479, and four UUIDs); Cloudinary stores those as
`display_name` and mints a separate opaque public_id, which is what a URL
needs. Resolved 2026-09-22 through the Admin search API. If a plate 404s,
search display_name rather than assuming the id was mistyped.
`pole` is the reference set’s own split (brand-tokens.css:60-72): `paper`
